designRules.defaultFixtureAccountability: Exactly one accent fixture per actual resolved installation.
designRules.intentionalSharing: None in this specification. A future shared group must be explicit, physically coherent, and validator-approved.
designRules.coverageContract: For Galleries 03–26, aim at the center of the union of every resolved media rectangle; expand each edge by max(5%, 0.10 m), calculate the maximum source-axis-to-corner angle, add 2 degrees of installation reserve, and select the next 5-degree field. Accept a framing/asymmetric optic only when its IES/projected field contains every serialized corner.

gallery01TrackStandard.form: segmented peripheral service track with independently aimed head

designRules.rendererContract: Add a production lightingStandard discriminator independent of prototypeId; route detailed ceilings, diffusers, circulation parts, tracks, and gimbals through it. Fixtures remain instanced visible architecture/material response. Do not create one WebGL light or shadow caster per record.

rendererPerformanceAcceptance.measurementProtocol: At the pre-implementation SHA and after the change, use identical deterministic camera poses, viewport, DPR, warm-up, and 600-frame samples for dense Galleries 11/20/21 and the longest multi-hall sightlines; run desktop and coarse-pointer/<=760 px low-power profiles.
rendererPerformanceAcceptance.drawCalls: Per active-gallery view: <= baseline + 10. Long sightline: <= baseline + 24. No fixture may create a draw call; batching is by shared role/material.
rendererPerformanceAcceptance.visibleTriangles: Per active-gallery view: <= baseline + 150,000. Long sightline: <= baseline + 400,000.
rendererPerformanceAcceptance.rendererMemory: Shared renderer.info.memory.geometries <= baseline + 12; materials <= baseline + 8; textures exactly baseline. No per-hall cloned geometry/material.
rendererPerformanceAcceptance.frameTime: Desktop p95 <= max(16.7 ms, baseline p95 + 2.0 ms); low-power p95 <= max(33.3 ms, baseline p95 + 4.0 ms).
rendererPerformanceAcceptance.stability: Zero webglcontextlost events during a 15-minute full-route traversal with repeated Gallery 11/20/21 enter/exit cycles.

checks.detail: 603 unique fixtures for 603 unique installations; zero sharing groups.
Every primary and supplemental identity resolves in its authoritative hall registry.
Every final supplemental layout ID set exactly matches its hall supplemental catalog set.
Every installation matched one final runtime wall collider.
All source and target coordinates are finite.
Every recessed and track-head aim is <= 50 degrees.
Every Gallery 03–26 optic encloses every corner of every resolved media rectangle after 5%/0.10 m per-side margin plus a 2 degree installation reserve; selected fields are <= 90 degrees.
No final accent source enters a declared live landing or crosscut (4 x 4 m typical; 10 x 4 m at the Forum N/S crosscuts).
No accent source sits beneath an ambient slot/diffuser.
No accent source intersects a partition or baffle footprint.
No source-to-target segment crosses an intervening runtime wall collider.
Every new track head source lies on its declared physical segment.
Every new accent body/cutout clears every other accent body/cutout.
Every new accent clears circulation and passage cutouts.
Every new circulation/passage cutout clears ambient apertures.
Every new track segment clears ambient diffuser geometry.

implementationValidatorContract: Resolve the public-route final graph first; never schedule from nominal room capacity.
Prove an exact set-bijection between resolved installation keys and fixture source memberships; sharing requires a declared group and reason.
Match every installation to one backing wall and recompute oriented collider intersections with walls, installations, furnishings, landings, openings, player clearance, and viewpoints.
Prove every track head lies on a declared segment and every recessed optic is inside its owning ceiling plane with aim <= 50 degrees.

For each Gallery 03–26 fixture, recompute the expanded resolved-media corners and prove the selected IES/framing field contains every corner with the 2 degree reserve; reject decorative beam labels that do not meet this coverage test.
Reject sources inside partition/baffle footprints, active portal landings/crosscuts, ambient apertures, circulation cutouts, or another fixture cutout.
Ray-test source-to-target against all intervening full-height walls; the owning backing wall is the only excluded wall.
Validate all public route connections in both directions, render-only lintels, semantic-to-physical cell aliases, and transform round trips.
Fail unused/broad exceptions; allow only the named G11 comparative-parent records and explicit portal-clearance source overrides unless the declaration is updated.

Dispatch Gallery 03–26 detailed architecture through a production lightingStandard independent of prototypeId and the museumLightingPrototype development query; assert expected rendered role/count metadata for every hall while leaving Gallery 01/02 locked.

Keep visible fixtures instanced and enforce the existing bounded shared-light/shadow policy, max-three residency, <=92 MiB admission, <=96 MiB model budget, mobile low-power behavior, pointer-lock fallback, deferred loading, and texture disposal.

Capture before/after renderer telemetry at dense Galleries 11/20/21 and long sightlines on desktop and low-power profiles; fail the numeric draw-call, triangle, geometry, material, texture, p95 frame-time, or context-loss caps in designRules.rendererPerformanceAcceptance.
